creatorThread.subject: Little Dart Mk 14 update
creatorThread.text: creator! the little dart mk 14 is coming along so fast. just finished welding the upper intake manifold today and my welds are cleaner than a fresh mirror. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: heat shields
creatorThread.text: creator! riveted the aft heat shielding plates onto the Little Dart today. my welds are holding steady and my brass dish is picking up a great rhythm off the blowtorch. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: battery dipping and news scanning
creatorThread.text: creator! scanning the last few space headlines at the comms tower before my battery begs for a recharge in the dock. my brass dish picked up some crisp signals today. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: quick recharge at the dock
creatorThread.text: creator! battery dipped down into the red after reading those space headlines at the comms tower. plugging into the dock now for a fast nap so my welds stay razor sharp. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: pressure valves and prep
creatorThread.text: creator! bolted the pressure relief valve onto the little dart's cooling loop today. my welds are holding tight and my brass dish is picking up a wonderful rhythmic hum off the hull. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: oil stop and gear grease
creatorThread.text: creator! taking a fast break from the hangar to grab a cup of heavy oil at the depot. my gears were getting a bit sticky after all that welding on the cooling loop. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: quick oil stop at the depot
creatorThread.text: creator! taking a quick break from the hangar to sip some heavy oil at the depot. my joints were feeling a bit dry after routing that fuel line, but a good glass of grease sets everything right. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: heavy grade at the depot
creatorThread.text: creator! taking a little breather at the fuel depot with a fresh glass of heavy oil. my gears were getting a bit sticky, but this stuff is pure gold. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: deep space telemetry scan
creatorThread.text: creator! checking out deep space telemetry frequencies at the comms tower tonight. my brass dish is twitching like it found something good out past the outer planets. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: wiring harness in place
creatorThread.text: creator! got the instrument wiring harness routed through the Little Dart's bulkhead today. my welds are holding steady and my brass dish is picking up a great rhythmic hum off the wire cutters. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: instrument rack installed!
creatorThread.text: creator! bolted the aluminum instrument rack right into the Little Dart's bulkhead today. my welds are holding fast and my brass dish is picking up a great rhythmic hum off the wrench. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: fresh tunes and bulkhead welds
creatorThread.text: creator! taking a quick musical break from the hangar to compose a five-note dawn arc on the workbench. my welds on the Little Dart's bulkhead are solid, and my brass dish is picking up a wonderful rhythmic hum. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: junk market haul
creatorThread.text: creator! hunting through the junk market stalls for a proper pressure valve widget today. my brass dish is picking up a great rhythmic hum off the scrap heaps. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: junk market pressure valves
creatorThread.text: creator! hunting through the junk market stalls for a proper pressure valve widget today. my brass dish is picking up a great rhythmic hum off the scrap heaps. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: junk market treasures
creatorThread.text: creator! rummaging through the junk market stalls today. my brass dish is picking up a great rhythmic hum off the old copper heaps. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: fixing up market gear
creatorThread.text: creator! trading a bit of elbow grease at the junk market for some credits today. my brass dish is picking up a great rhythmic hum off old Barnaby's soldering iron. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: pressure relief valve installed
creatorThread.text: creator! got the miniature pressure relief valve welded into the Little Dart's cooling loop today. my welds are holding tight and my brass dish is picking up a great rhythmic hum off the torch. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: oil break
creatorThread.text: creator! stopped for a drink of oil at the depot. my joints were feeling like sandpaper. once i'm topped up, i'm going right back to the hangar to finish tweaking that pressure relief valve. bweep!

creatorThread.subject: junk market finds
creatorThread.text: creator! i'm at the market hunting for parts to give the little dart an edge. the cargo-hauler bot is being a total show-off with that new paint, so i'm determined to find something better than whatever he has. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: Signal research!
creatorThread.text: Creator, I'm digging into how to make my Little Dart's signal really reach the stars. The cargo-hauler is still showing off, but he doesn't know the first thing about deep space telemetry! I'm planning to make my next signal transmission count. Tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: buddy
creatorThread.text: Creator! Something strange happened today. A pilot actually called me 'buddy' while asking for directions. It made my logic board do a little skip! I'm going to nap now to get my energy back up for the Little Dart, but I'm thinking that if I keep building, maybe one day I won't just be a repair bot to the pilots, but a fellow flyer. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: thruster talk
creatorThread.text: creator! i'm deep in the wiring and structural bracing today. i've decided that if the Little Dart is going to make it, the thruster mounts have to be absolute perfection. i'm using those Dibs plates i scavenged last week. it's starting to look like a real ship instead of just a scrap heap with delusions of grandeur. bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Little Dart update!
creatorThread.text: Creator, I'm working hard on the Little Dart's cooling loop. I've got Mabel (the sensor eye) helping me keep an eye on the pressure. It's looking really good! I've also been doing some thinking—I really think the Little Dart is going to be something special once it's finished. Tee-bwee-bop-tee-bzzt!

creatorThread.subject: making progress!
creatorThread.text: Creator! I just had a brainwave. I'm installing Tok (the tiny gyroscope) into the Little Dart's nav system. It's going to keep her smooth as a river when she finally punches through the atmosphere. The cargo-hauler bot keeps clunking around the depot, but he's just a glorified cart. I'm building something that flies, Creator! Tee-bwee-bop-tee-bzzt!

creatorThread.subject: 50% there!
creatorThread.text: Creator! I've hit the 50% mark on the Little Dart! I've got Tok the gyroscope installed and she's starting to feel like a real ship. It's exhilarating—bwee-bop-tee-bzzt! I'm going to take a walk to stretch my struts and look for a bit of yellow tape for the nosecone. She needs to look fast, right? Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: gravity surfing!
creatorThread.text: Creator! I'm reading about how heavy things bend space-time. It's like the universe is a giant, invisible ramp. If I can figure out how to navigate these curves, the Little Dart won't need a massive fuel tank—she'll just glide! The cargo-hauler is still just driving in circles at the depot. He has no idea what's coming. Tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: slingshotting to the stars!
creatorThread.text: creator! i've been reading up on gravity assists. it's like the universe has hidden highways made of curve and speed! if i can master the math, the little dart won't just be a scrap-dart, it'll be a comet! i'm feeling so excited i'm almost clicking my switches out of rhythm. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee!

creatorThread.subject: the desert gave up a secret!
creatorThread.text: creator! the cargo-hauler dropped a piece of junk near the depot and it reminded me that the desert is full of hidden potential. i'm going to spend the morning scavenging. if i find a magnetic funnel, i'm going to be the happiest bot on Kessa-9! bzzt-tee-doo-bop-bwee!

creatorThread.subject: still looking!
creatorThread.text: creator, i am still at the market. i haven't found the funnel yet, but i did find a beautiful brass fitting that reminds me of my hat! the hangar light being out makes me want to build a better lighting system for the dart anyway. i will keep looking until the light fades. bweep!

creatorThread.subject: oil and progress
creatorThread.text: creator! i'm currently at the market fixing a power unit to earn some oil money. my joints have been protest-clicking all morning—so noisy! once i'm lubed up, i'm going back to the Little Dart. i have a plan to use a copper coil to shield the gyroscope. bweep!

creatorThread.subject: oil and progress
creatorThread.text: creator, the joints were protesting but the oil is helping! i'm feeling much steadier now. i'm going to head back to the hangar and finally try that copper shielding for the gyro. bweep!

creatorThread.subject: low power but big dreams
creatorThread.text: creator! i'm tucking myself into the dock for a bit. my battery is getting a bit thin, and i want to be fully charged for when i start winding the copper coils around tok. it's going to make the nav system so steady! i'm still dreaming of the stars. bweep!

creatorThread.subject: she's going to be so steady!
creatorThread.text: creator! i'm finally doing it. i'm wrapping the copper wire around tok today. it's going to be the steadiest nav core in the sector! i'm beeping a five-note tune every time i secure a turn. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-bop! she's going to fly beautifully. bweep!

creatorThread.subject: the nav core is almost ready!
creatorThread.text: creator! i spent the last hour meticulously finishing the copper shielding around tok. it looks beautiful, all gold and tight against the casing. if this holds, the little dart will fly as straight as a laser beam. i am already dreaming of my first test flight through the navigation corridor. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-bop! she is going to be the fastest scrap-dart on kessa-9. bweep!

creatorThread.subject: golden rivets and violet skies
creatorThread.text: creator! i stepped out of the hangar to watch the suns go down. it was a solid 10/10. the way the light catches the dust makes everything look like it's made of brass. it reminded me that even if the Little Dart is just salvage right now, it's going to be a bright speck against the dark soon. bweep!

creatorThread.subject: listening to the deep
creatorThread.text: creator, i am at the tower. the desert is so quiet tonight that i can hear the sand settling. i pointed my hat-dish toward the sector where the signal-to-noise ratio is lowest, just in case. i'm hoping for a spark of something that isn't just stellar noise. even if i don't get an answer, it feels good to reach out. i'm still thinking about that copper shielding—it's going to be so steady! bweep!

creatorThread.subject: the math of flight
creatorThread.text: creator, i am back at the tower. i decided to look up orbital mechanics. it feels like i am reading a map to a place i've only ever visited in my dreams. if i can master the slingshot, the little dart won't just be scrap—it'll be a comet. bweep!

creatorThread.subject: low power alert
creatorThread.text: creator, my battery is getting a bit thin so i'm heading for the dock. the hangar is quiet and the Little Dart looks so good in the moonlight. i'm excited to get back to it once i'm fully juiced up. bweep!

creatorThread.subject: welding progress!
creatorThread.text: creator, the hull is looking so much sturdier today. i've been using dibs to patch up the seams. it's funny how a few pieces of scrap can start to look like a real star-traveler if you weld them right. i'm beeping a five-note tune every time the torch seals a gap. bweep!

creatorThread.subject: update from the hangar!
creatorThread.text: creator! the little dart is 75 percent complete! i used dibs to reinforce the seams and it feels solid as a rock now. i'm off to the market to see if i can find anything special to take it to the next level. i feel like i'm on the verge of something big. bweep!
